notes.title: English version updated!
notes.content:
The English subtitle for  is finally released!
We appreciate 冬天de细语(NaCeel) for the translation! We won't have this new version without the hard work of the translator.

The new version is built on top of a new game engine. 
Save data between the original and the current version is incompatible.
If you would like to play the original version, switch to the 'original' branch in "Properties - Betas".

The game will automatically switch to English subtitles if your steam language setting is English.
You can also select language at "Properties - Language".

We also appreciate all players from all over the world who supported us during these years.
Thank you for your patience! It is really a long journey for localization and porting.

During the winter sale, all players who bought 'Tiny Snow - Love Package' will still get a free copy of . This package will be offline after the winter sale.

We'll keep improving the localization content. Let us know if you find any issues.
Please feel free to mail us at info@nvlsoft.com

notes.title: The Love is Pricesless - Free Game for Supporters
notes.content:
Memes comes and goes, but love will remain.

If you visit this page because of the #tinysnow meme from Reddit or Twitter, we appreciate your support! We're all happy developers and we love life and games. We hope you could enjoy our game instead of buying it as donation.

Just wishlist it till English version out. Or a 'like' is good enough to keep us warm! For thoese who already bought the game, we'd like to thank you by something more.

This package now includes a free copy of 'Season of 12 Colors', which is a story about love with English subtitle (and proper age rating :12hat:) It is a small gift from us for all the loves you've shared. All the players who purchased or purchases now will get the copy, the game should be added to your library automatically. 

We'll keep this package until the English version finally release in future.

Enjoy the game and have a nice weekend!

May the world full of love instead of hatred and sadness :12paperplane:
